title: Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01821v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. translated_title: 超越线性概念：发现并对齐大语言模型中的非线性概念流形
translated_abstract: 理解大语言模型（LLM）的信息处理过程需要剖析其内部词元表示的几何组织结构。尽管现有的机制可解释性（MI）方法试图提取概念，但它们受到强线性假设的约束，而非线性特征流形的存在证据对此假设构成了挑战。我们超越了线性概念的局限，将计算机视觉领域的非线性多维概念发现方法（NLMCD）改造应用于词元级别的LLM激活，将概念建模为低维流形。为了比较不同层和不同模型之间的概念流形，我们引入了基于概念的对齐（CBA）分数，这是一种广义的兰德指数（Rand index），能够在无需显式特征匹配的情况下衡量几何接近度。我们的分析得出了六项关键发现：（i）相邻层合理性检验表明CBA比基于PCA或CKA的线性基线方法更为敏感；（ii）逐层对齐矩阵揭示了两个块结构……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将计算机视觉中的非线性多维概念发现方法（NLMCD）引入大语言模型的词元级激活分析，把概念建模为低维非线性流形，并提出基于概念的对齐分数（CBA）来衡量不同层与模型间概念流形的几何接近度，突破了传统机制可解释性方法强线性假设的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional non-linear manifolds, and introduces a Concept-Based Alignment (CBA) score to measure geometric proximity of concept manifolds across layers and models, moving beyond the strong linearity assumption of existing mechanistic interpretability methods.
